postStart.cli: zsh -ic 'python3 scripts/localhost_tcp_forward.py --listen-host 127.0.0.1 --listen-port 17860 --target-host ${WENDY_HOSTNAME} --target-port 7860 & proxy_pid=$!; trap "kill ${proxy_pid}" EXIT INT TERM; sleep 1; wendy-dev utils open-browser http://localhost:17860/client/; wait ${proxy_pid}'
